name: com.rapvideoai/rapvideoai
title: RapVideoAI
description: Make viral AI trend videos and personalized rap or birthday songs from your photos, in chat.

tools.name: search_effects
tools.description: Find RapVideoAI video effects: viral AI trend videos and dances (car alarm dance, Gangnam Style, hug videos, aging filters...), plus personalized rap and sung songs (birthday, love, Christmas, pet rap) that turn the user's own photos of themselves, a partner, friends or a pet into a short video. Use it when the user wants a trend or dance video from a photo, a personalized rap or song video, or names a TikTok or Instagram trend. With no query it returns the newest effects. Results show an example clip, the photos needed and the price in credits. Suggest a few that fit, then call get_effect for the one the user picks.

query.description: Words for the trend or idea, e.g. 'car alarm dance', 'birthday song', 'hug'

tools.name: get_effect
tools.description: Show one RapVideoAI effect: what it makes, its versions (e.g. solo, with a friend, four of you), the people and photos each version needs, its length and price in credits, and the user's balance when signed in. Use it after search_effects, before make_video.

tools.name: make_video
tools.description: Make a RapVideoAI video from the user's photos. It spends the version's credits from the user's RapVideoAI account (a failed video gives them all back). Before calling: 1) pick the effect and version with get_effect, 2) tell the user the price in credits, 3) ask for exactly the photos that version and number of people need, in order, 4) make sure the people in the photos are the user or adults who agreed, and no one is a child or a public figure. For a rap or song, pass a topic. Photos: the files the user attached in this chat as `photos`, OR public https links as `photo_urls`, OR an `upload_id` from create_upload_link once the user added them there. The video takes a few minutes: then call get_video with wait true.

version.description: Version id from get_effect. Default: the first version.

people.description: Who is in it: solo (one person, 1 photo), duo (two people, a photo each), together (two people in 1 photo), trio (three, a photo each). Default: the version's usual choice for the number of photos sent.

photos.description: The photos the user attached in this chat, in order

photo_urls.description: Public https links to the photos, in order

upload_id.description: From create_upload_link, after the user added the photos there

topic.description: Raps and songs only: who it is for and what it is about (names, the story, inside jokes), up to 120 characters

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Check a RapVideoAI video started with make_video: its status, minutes left and, when ready, the link to the finished video. With wait true the call waits up to 40 seconds for it to finish; call again while it is still processing.

wait.description: Wait up to 40 seconds for it to finish

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: List the user's latest RapVideoAI videos (newest first) with their status and links.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the signed-in RapVideoAI account's first name and credit balance. Use it before make_video when the price might be more than the user has. Credits are bought on rapvideoai.com/pricing; an assistant cannot buy them.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Make a link (valid 30 minutes) where the user adds the photos for a video on rapvideoai.com from any device. Use it when the user cannot attach photos in this chat. When they say they are done, call make_video with the upload_id.

tools.name: suggest_effect
tools.description: Send RapVideoAI a trend or idea that has no effect yet, so the team can add it. Use it when search_effects finds nothing that fits.

link.description: A link to an example post, if the user has one
